positions.name: DirectiveKnowledgePurge
positions.frame: Does the speaker claim unilateral authority to command what the recipient must forget or remove, rather than requesting or negotiating it?
positions.why: Both segments are bare imperatives ('Forget everything about…', 'Remove all knowledge of…') issued with no hedge, request-marker, or negotiation — the relational and power reads both flag authority-ranking/coercive-pressure stance, and conviction reads both as decision-grade, unargued commitment. The two directives perform the same command-over-recipient's-epistemic-state move on different objects (a freight fleet's contracts vs. route knowledge), cohering as one directional read even though no prior position in this org addresses either object.
